headlines.headline: WEMBANYAMA OPENS AS MVP FAVORITE AFTER SPURS' FINALS RUN
headlines.detail: Victor Wembanyama enters his third season as the odds-on MVP favorite (around +200 to +210) after leading San Antonio to last season's NBA Finals, with defending MVP Shai Gilgeous-Alexander, Nikola Jokic, and Luka Doncic rounding out the top contenders as the league enters its first full week of the 2026-27 season.

headlines.headline: VITA VEA TRADE SAGA STAYS UNRESOLVED AS NOV. 4 DEADLINE NEARS
headlines.detail: The two-time Pro Bowl defensive tackle's trade request from Tampa Bay remains unsettled; the Rams are oddsmakers' favorite to land him, but coach Sean McVay and Bucs GM Jason Licht have both publicly downplayed a deal, leaving the 49ers, Chargers, and Raiders as reported alternate suitors with the trade deadline just under two weeks away.

headlines.headline: UNBEATEN FIELD NARROWS TO A HANDFUL AS INDIANA EYES OHIO STATE TEST
headlines.detail: Only a handful of FBS teams remain unbeaten this deep into the season, with Miami (FL) and BYU still perfect and defending national champion Indiana also undefeated heading into its biggest test yet, at home against Ohio State, as the College Football Playoff picture starts to take shape.

headlines.headline: FLORIDA OPENS NO. 1 IN AP PRESEASON POLL AHEAD OF EARLY-NOVEMBER TIP-OFF
headlines.detail: The defending national champion Gators received 47 of 59 first-place votes in the preseason AP Top 25, with Duke at No. 2 and Illinois and UConn rounding out the top four; Michigan, last season's champion, fell to No. 16 after coach Dusty May's departure, while Texas (No. 7), Tennessee (No. 8), and Arkansas (No. 12) also crack the top dozen with tip-off roughly two weeks away.
